name: talentsia-skill-template
description: Template plugin showing how Talentsia structures reusable skills: one shared method, self-contained exports, explicit authority and bounded subagents.

interface.shortDescription: Scaffold for new Talentsia skill packs
interface.longDescription: A starting point for new Talentsia skill packs. It contains one placeholder skill, a canonical shared method under references/, a compressed pocket method, a subagent role template and package instructions. Copy the plugin, rename it, replace every <placeholder> and remove this sentence before publishing. It performs no work of its own, stores nothing, connects to nothing and grants no permission.
defaultPrompt: Use Template Skill to show how a Talentsia skill reads its method, bounds its work and reports its result.
